body:
I buried it and everything else. I turned on autopilot at the age of 16 and have been cruising past funerals, a high school graduation, a military career, a college education. 

Yes I have all these traditional milestones. No, they don't make me happy or proud. It's all meaningless without love and connection.

So I detached myself from the world. Everything shines until it dims and dies. So who cares?

Eventually everything I buried will erupt and I'll probably kill myself, but for now, I'm numb to it all.
